messages.subject: Internal Server Error when trying to download ACOTSP Training instances
messages.subject_clean: Internal Server Error when trying to download ACOTSP Training instances
messages.body_plain:
Dear IRace Team,

I hope my email finds you well and safe!

I appreciate your time reading my message.

My name is Andrada and I'm a student who would like to test the irace package and to understand how it works.

I wanted to download the ACOTSP training and testing instances, however, it is not possible because of the following Internal Server Error.

Can you please kindly let me know if there is any other method to download the training instances files?

Thank you!

Sincerely,

Andrada
